label: Bible Study
prompt: Honour all men. Love the _____. Fear God. Honour the king.
verse: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
note: Four quick commands — honour everyone, love the church, fear God, honour the king.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the _____, the first and the last.
verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
note: Jesus is the A to Z, start to finish — nothing comes before Him or after.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a _____ east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
verse: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
note: First the gourd withered, then a vehement east wind and a beating sun — and Jonah asked to die over it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: That being justified by his grace, we should be made _____ according to the hope of eternal life.
verse: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
note: Grace does more than acquit the guilty — it writes them into the will as heirs.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Many shall be _____, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verse: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
note: In the end 'many shall be purified, and made white, and tried' — and only the wise shall understand.
